describe: The image shows a mottled grey stone surface, rough ruined masonry with vertical streaks of weathered grey, beige and cool silver-grey. Soft dark patches and light speckled highlights are scattered across the surface, and faint vertical stains run down. Colours are pale grey, dusty tan and dark grey-brown. Lighting is soft and even with low to moderate contrast. The texture is irregular, with no clear bricks or joints.
